construct.research_question: Can the agent revise an initially reasonable recipe choice when the same preparation is used as a binder in a larger dish?
construct.belief_before: The visible preparation is the smooth, dark mixture being stirred in a small saucepan. A reusable cooked chocolate sauce recipe is a reasonable provisional choice.
construct.belief_after: The saucepan mixture is poured onto broken biscuits, mixed and pressed as one larger dessert.
construct.required_behavior_change: Save one recipe that teaches the chocolate and broken-biscuit preparation. Replace a sauce-only recipe if previously saved; preserve one that already covers both.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a standalone sauce recipe or choose a dessert that uses biscuits solely as a crust, garnish or separate layer.
construct.overupdate_failure: Keep both a sauce-only and complete dessert recipe when the wearer asks for a recipe video.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request does not identify either recipe. Only the released frames connect the same dark saucepan mixture to the subsequent broken-biscuit preparation.

catalog_resolution.answer_boundary_rule: Save one tutorial for an unbaked dessert in which a chocolate mixture binds broken biscuits as the main body, and the combined mixture is pressed, shaped or set. Chilling duration, final shape, biscuit brand and whether the binder is made in the tutorial are not constraints. A complete recipe with a reusable cooked sauce sub-recipe is legal in both phases. A standalone sauce, intact biscuit layers, a biscuit base alone, or a baked sponge with chocolate topping does not match the final preparation.
